proposals.before: He was moved to Bozhou, made Northwest Circuit Pacification Commissioner, and then promoted to Commissioner of the Wugu Shilei tribal command.
proposals.after: He was moved to Bozhou, made Assistant Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit, and then promoted to Commissioner of the Wugu Shilei tribal command.
proposals.reason: Chinese 西北路招討都監 is the deputy/assistant pacification post, not the full commissioner; the idiomatic English drops 都監.

proposals.before: He was transferred to Bozhou, changed to Northwest Circuit Pacification Commissioner, and promoted to Commissioner of the Wugu Shilei Tribal Command.
proposals.after: He was transferred to Bozhou, changed to Northwest Circuit Assistant Pacification Commissioner, and promoted to Commissioner of the Wugu Shilei Tribal Command.
proposals.reason: The literal English likewise omits 都監 and renders a deputy office as a full pacification commissioner.

proposals.before: When the court sent Grand Councilor Pusans Zhongyi to replace Mouyan in command, Xiang again followed Zhongyi in pursuit to Xianquan west of Niaoling. He overtook the enemy, led the right wing in a personal charge, and routed them so completely that men and horses trampled one another to death; Xianquan was nearly cleared.
proposals.after: When the court sent Grand Councilor Pusan Zhongyi to replace Mouyan in command, Xiang again followed Zhongyi in pursuit to Xianquan west of Niaoling. He overtook the enemy, led the right wing in a personal charge, and routed them so completely that men and horses trampled one another to death; Xianquan was nearly cleared.
proposals.reason: The surname 僕散 is Pusan, not the pluralized 'Pusans'.

proposals.before: It happened that the court sent the Grand Councilor Pusans Zhongyi to replace Mouyan as commander; Xiang again followed Zhongyi in pursuing the rebels to Xianquan west of Niaoling, overtook them, led the right wing and charged ahead in person; the rebels were greatly routed, men and horses trampling one another to death; Xianquan was nearly pacified.
proposals.after: It happened that the court sent the Grand Councilor Pusan Zhongyi to replace Mouyan as commander; Xiang again followed Zhongyi in pursuing the rebels to Xianquan west of Niaoling, overtook them, led the right wing and charged ahead in person; the rebels were greatly routed, men and horses trampling one another to death; Xianquan was nearly pacified.
proposals.reason: The surname 僕散 is Pusan, not 'Pusans'.

proposals.before: When Song sued for peace and the army withdrew, he was summoned as Commander of the Archway Guard Direct, made Right Guard General of the Hall Army, then Left Guard General, sent out as Northeast Circuit Pacification Commissioner, promoted to Commissioner of the Supin Circuit, and finally transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Yilan Circuit forces.
proposals.after: When Song sued for peace and the army withdrew, he was summoned as Commander of the Archway Guard Direct, made Right Guard General of the Hall Army, then Left Guard General, sent out as Northeast Circuit Pacification Vice-Commissioner (dujian), promoted to Commissioner of the Supin Circuit, and finally transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Yilan Circuit forces.
proposals.reason: 東北路招討都監 is a vice-commissioner/supervisor (都監), not the full pacification commissioner.

proposals.before: Shizong, the principal imperial grandson of the Prince of Jinyuan, was to receive a princely title, and the court ordered a state name chosen for the enfeoffment.
proposals.after: Shizong, taking the Prince of Jinyuan, who was the principal imperial grandson, was about to confer a princely title, and an edict ordered a state name chosen for the enfeoffment.
proposals.reason: 世宗以金源郡王世嫡皇孫 means Shizong acted regarding the Prince of Jinyuan, the principal imperial grandson; the English inverts the relationship.

proposals.before: Shizong, as the principal imperial grandson of the Prince of Jinyuan, was about to be granted princely rank, and an edict was issued to select a state name.
proposals.after: Shizong, taking the Prince of Jinyuan as the principal imperial grandson, was about to confer princely rank, and an edict was issued to select a state name.
proposals.reason: The recipient of the new princely state-name is the Prince of Jinyuan, not Shizong.

proposals.before: On his return Shizong questioned him about frontier affairs. Xiang submitted detailed maps and proposed policies to keep dependent tribes loyal and to subdue Dashi of the Qara Khitai. The emperor ordered all of it carried out.
proposals.after: On his return Shizong questioned him about frontier affairs. Xiang submitted detailed maps and proposed policies to keep dependent tribes loyal and to hold the Dashi (Qara Khitai) in check. The emperor ordered all of it carried out.
proposals.reason: 鎮服大石 refers to the Dashi/Western Liao regime, not a living individual named Dashi.

proposals.before: The eastern force reached the Longju River and was surrounded by Beizu Xu. Trapped for three days, it sent urgent appeals for help. Some urged Xiang to wait until the full army had gathered.
proposals.after: The eastern force reached the Longju River and was surrounded by Zu Xu. Trapped for three days, it sent urgent appeals for help. Some urged waiting until the full army had gathered.
proposals.reason: Chinese 或請俟諸軍集乃發 has no name Xiang; inserting Xiang invents a vocative. 阻珝 is not Beizu.

proposals.before: In the tenth month Beizu Xu rebelled again, and Xiang marched out to encamp at Beijing. At the same time the Khitan herding-office leaders Deshou and Tuosuo seized Xizhou, declared a reign title of Shengsheng, and claimed an army of hundreds of thousands, throwing the region into alarm.
proposals.after: In the tenth month Zu Xu rebelled again, and Xiang marched out to encamp at Beijing. At the same time the Khitan herding-office leaders Deshou and Tuosuo seized Xizhou, declared a reign title of Shensheng, and claimed an army of hundreds of thousands, throwing the region into alarm.
proposals.reason: The rebel era name is 身聖 (Shensheng), not Shengsheng; 阻珝 should not be rendered Beizu Xu.

proposals.before: In the tenth month Beizu Xu rebelled again; Xiang went out to encamp at Beijing; meanwhile the herding-office Khitan Deshou, Tuosuo, and others seized Xizhou in rebellion, falsely establishing an era title called Shengsheng, claiming hundreds of thousands of followers, and all near and far were shaken.
proposals.after: In the tenth month Zu Xu rebelled again; Xiang went out to encamp at Beijing; meanwhile the herding-office Khitan Deshou, Tuosuo, and others seized Xizhou in rebellion, falsely establishing an era title called Shensheng, claiming hundreds of thousands of followers, and all near and far were shaken.
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise mistransliterates 身聖 as Shengsheng and 阻珝 as Beizu Xu.

proposals.before: The following year he left office to observe mourning for a close relative.
proposals.after: The following year he left office to observe mourning for his mother.
proposals.reason: 內艱 is the conventional term for mourning a mother, not an unspecified close relative.

proposals.before: As a northern campaign was debated, Xiang proposed sending Zonghao, Deputy Director of the Great Closer-of-Kin Office, to lead troops from Taizhou; sending Left Vice Minister Heng to establish a mobile Military Affairs Commission at Fuzhou to march Northwest Circuit forces against Beizu Xu; and leading his own army out from Linhuang.
proposals.after: As a northern campaign was debated, Xiang proposed sending Zonghao, Deputy Director of the Great Closer-of-Kin Office, to lead troops from Taizhou; sending Left Vice Minister Heng to establish a mobile Military Affairs Commission at Fuzhou to march Northwest Circuit forces to intercept the Zubu; and leading his own army out from Linhuang.
proposals.reason: 邀阻珝 is the Zubu (阻卜) tribal name, not a person Beizu Xu; 珝 is a corruption of 卜.

proposals.before: A drought was then afflicting the realm. The court ordered the relevant offices to pray for rain, and Xiang, together with Grand Chancellor Zhang Wannu, Vice Grand Chancellor Pusan Kui, and others submitted memorials accepting blame.
proposals.after: A drought was then afflicting the realm. The court ordered the relevant offices to pray for rain, and Xiang, together with Grand Chancellor Zhang Wangong, Vice Grand Chancellor Pusan Kui, and others submitted memorials accepting blame.
proposals.reason: 張萬公 is Zhang Wangong; Wannu is a mistransliteration of 萬公.

proposals.before: Jiagu Heng, whose original name was Alibu, came from the Sandu Meng'an Yida baimouke in Shandong West Circuit.
proposals.after: Jiagu Heng, whose original name was Alibu, came from the Santu Meng'an Yida baimouke in Shandong West Circuit.
proposals.reason: 三土 is Santu, not Sandu; the circuit affiliation is otherwise correctly rendered.

proposals.before: Jiagu Heng, original name Alibu, was a man of the Sandu Meng'an Yida baimouke in Shandong West Circuit.
proposals.after: Jiagu Heng, original name Alibu, was a man of the Santu Meng'an Yida baimouke in Shandong West Circuit.
proposals.reason: 三土 should be transcribed Santu rather than Sandu.

proposals.before: Heng said: "If it were merely profitable, the ancients would already have practiced it. Moreover, it requires much labor for little planted area; I also fear wasteland would be abandoned and the people would toil in vain without benefit."
proposals.after: Heng said: "If it were merely profitable, the ancients would already have practiced it. Moreover, it requires much labor for little planted area; I also fear farmland would be left waste and the people would toil in vain without benefit."
proposals.reason: 荒廢土田 means cultivated land going to waste, not that wasteland would be abandoned; 若苟有利 is also closer to 'if it were truly profitable' than 'merely'.

proposals.before: He was twice promoted, to Deputy Commissioner of the Ceremonial Guard Bureau.
proposals.after: He was promoted again to Deputy Commissioner of the Ceremonial Guard Bureau.
proposals.reason: 再遷 marks a further promotion, not necessarily two promotions to that office; the idiomatic rendering is accurate.

proposals.before: In the first year of Taihe he was specially granted the hereditary meng'an of Yanyan River in the Southwest Circuit, concurrently hezha baimouke.
proposals.after: In the first year of Taihe he was specially granted the hereditary meng'an of Yanyan River in the Southwest Circuit, concurrently hezha mouke.
proposals.reason: 合劄謀克 is a hezha mouke; English “baimouke” fuses characters that are not in the source.

proposals.before: In the first year of Taihe he was specially granted the hereditary meng'an of Yanyan River in the Southwest Circuit, concurrently hezha baimouke.
proposals.after: In the first year of Taihe he was specially granted the hereditary meng'an of Yanyan River in the Southwest Circuit, concurrently hezha mouke.
proposals.reason: Same fusion of 合劄謀克 as “baimouke” in the literal field.

proposals.before: Yaoli Beidie came from the Tuoluo Mountain meng'an in the Kubai meng'an district of the Beijing Circuit.
proposals.after: Yaoli Beidie came from the Tuoluo Mountain mouke under the Kubai meng'an of the Beijing Circuit.
proposals.reason: 陀羅山謀克 is a mouke, not a meng'an; 窟白猛安 is the parent meng'an.

proposals.before: Yaoli Beidie was a man of the Tuoluo Mountain meng'an in Kubai meng'an, Beijing Circuit.
proposals.after: Yaoli Beidie was a man of the Tuoluo Mountain mouke in the Kubai meng'an, Beijing Circuit.
proposals.reason: 謀克 is mouke; rendering both levels as meng'an collapses the source offices.

proposals.before: In the second year of Cheng'an more than a thousand Khitan horsemen raided back and forth between Jin and Yi. Beidie pursued and defeated them, recovered the booty, and returned everything to the original households.
proposals.after: In the second year of Cheng'an more than a thousand Khitan horsemen raided back and forth between Jinzhou and Yizhou. Beidie pursued and defeated them, recovered the booty, and returned everything to the original households.
proposals.reason: 錦、懿 are Jinzhou and Yizhou; “Jin” reads as the dynasty name.

proposals.before: In the second year of Cheng'an, more than a thousand Khitan troops appeared and vanished raiding between Jin and Yi; Beidie pursued and defeated them, recovered what had been plundered, and returned it all to the original households.
proposals.after: In the second year of Cheng'an, more than a thousand Khitan troops appeared and vanished raiding between Jinzhou and Yizhou; Beidie pursued and defeated them, recovered what had been plundered, and returned it all to the original households.
proposals.reason: 錦、懿 are prefectures Jinzhou and Yizhou, not the Jin dynasty.

proposals.before: In the third year he followed Associate Director of the Great Mujin Office Zonghao as commander of the left wing, fought at the Yimi River, and won;
proposals.after: In the third year he followed Associate Director of the Great Court of the Imperial Clan Zonghao as commander of the left wing, fought at the Yimi River, and won;
proposals.reason: 大睦親府 is the court of imperial-clan affairs, not a “Mujin Office.”

proposals.before: The encomium says: In the first six of the Army hexagram in the Changes: "The army sets forth according to discipline; ill fortune and harm follow."
proposals.after: The encomium says: In the first yin line (chu liu) of the Army hexagram in the Changes: "The army sets forth according to discipline; ill fortune and harm follow."
proposals.reason: 初六 is the first yin line of the hexagram, not “first six.”

decisions.reason: 西北路招討都監 is the assistant/supervisory pacification post (都監), not the full 招討使. The original English drops 都監.
The literal likewise renders 招討都監 as a full pacification commissioner; Assistant Pacification Commissioner restores 都監.
僕散 is the Jurchen surname Pusan; Pusans wrongly pluralizes it.
The same 僕散忠義 must be Pusan Zhongyi in the literal field, not Pusans.

decisions.after: When Song sued for peace and the army withdrew, he was summoned as Commander of the Archway Guard Direct, made Right Guard General of the Hall Army, then Left Guard General, sent out as Northeast Circuit Assistant Pacification Commissioner, promoted to Commissioner of the Supin Circuit, and finally transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Yilan Circuit forces.
decisions.reason: 東北路招討都監 is the assistant pacification post, not the full commissioner. The parenthetical (dujian) is awkward in idiomatic English; Assistant Pacification Commissioner restores 都監 without a gloss.

decisions.after: Because the Prince of Jinyuan was the principal imperial grandson, Shizong was about to confer a princely title on him, and an edict ordered a state name chosen for the enfeoffment.
decisions.reason: 世宗以金源郡王世嫡皇孫，將加王爵 makes Shizong the actor and the Prince of Jinyuan, the principal imperial grandson, the recipient. The original inverts that kinship; the proposal’s “taking the Prince of Jinyuan” is a stiff calque of 以.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 世宗以金源郡王世嫡皇孫，將加王爵，詔擇國號

decisions.reason: The literal correctly restores Shizong as the one conferring rank on the Prince of Jinyuan, the 世嫡皇孫, rather than making Shizong the grandson.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 世宗以金源郡王世嫡皇孫，將加王爵

decisions.reason: 鎮服大石 names the Dashi/Qara Khitai regime, not a living individual “Dashi of the Qara Khitai.”

decisions.after: The eastern force reached the Longju River and was surrounded by the Zuxu. Trapped for three days, it sent urgent appeals for help. Some urged waiting until the full army had gathered.
decisions.reason: 為阻珝所圍 and 或請俟諸軍集乃發 name the Zuxu and an unnamed request to wait; Beizu Xu invents a personal name, and Zu Xu still treats 阻珝 as an individual. The same juan’s 北阻珝 shows a people. Removing the invented vocative Xiang is right.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 東軍至龍駒河為阻珝所圍

decisions.after: In the tenth month the Zuxu rebelled again, and Xiang marched out to encamp at Beijing. At the same time the Khitan herding-office leaders Deshou and Tuosuo seized Xinzhou, declared a reign title of Shensheng, and claimed an army of hundreds of thousands, throwing the region into alarm.
decisions.reason: 身聖 is Shensheng, not Shengsheng, and 阻珝 is the Zuxu people, not Beizu Xu. The proposal still leaves 信州 as Xizhou; 信州 is Xinzhou.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 十月，阻珝複叛……據信州叛，偽建元曰身聖

decisions.after: In the tenth month the Zuxu rebelled again; Xiang went out to encamp at Beijing; meanwhile the herding-office Khitan Deshou, Tuosuo, and others seized Xinzhou in rebellion, falsely establishing an era title called Shensheng, claiming hundreds of thousands of followers, and all near and far were shaken.
decisions.reason: The literal must likewise read 阻珝 as the Zuxu, 身聖 as Shensheng, and 信州 as Xinzhou.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 阻珝複叛……據信州叛，偽建元曰身聖

decisions.reason: 內艱 is the conventional term for mourning a mother, not an unspecified close relative.

decisions.after: As a northern campaign was debated, Xiang proposed sending Zonghao, Deputy Director of the Great Closer-of-Kin Office, to lead troops from Taizhou; sending Left Vice Minister Heng to establish a mobile Military Affairs Commission at Fuzhou to march Northwest Circuit forces to intercept the Zuxu; and leading his own army out from Linhuang.
decisions.reason: 邀阻珝 is intercepting the Zuxu as a people, not a person Beizu Xu. Wikisource and Chinese Notes both print 阻珝 (and 北阻珝) in this juan, so the received text is not 阻卜; emending to Zubu is unsupported by those witnesses.
張萬公 is Zhang Wangong; Wannu misreads 萬公.
三土 is Santu, not Sandu.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 山東西路三土猛安益打把謀克人

decisions.reason: The literal must likewise transcribe 三土 as Santu.

decisions.after: Heng said: "If it were truly profitable, the ancients would already have practiced it. Moreover, it requires much labor for little planted area; I also fear farmland would be left waste and the people would toil in vain without benefit."
decisions.reason: 荒廢土田 is cultivated land going to waste, not abandoning wasteland. The proposal still keeps “merely” for 若苟有利, which is “if it were indeed/truly profitable,” as the idiomatic already has.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 若苟有利……複恐荒廢土田

decisions.reason: 再遷 marks a further promotion, not two promotions into that office.
合劄謀克 is a hezha mouke; baimouke fuses in 把, which is not in this title.
The literal likewise must read 合劄謀克 as hezha mouke, not baimouke.
陀羅山謀克 is a mouke under the 窟白猛安; calling Tuoluo Mountain a meng'an collapses the two offices.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 北京路窟白猛安陀羅山謀克人

decisions.reason: The literal must distinguish 窟白猛安 from 陀羅山謀克.

decisions.after: In the second year of Cheng'an more than a thousand horsemen raided back and forth between Jinzhou and Yizhou. Beidie pursued and defeated them, recovered the booty, and returned everything to the original households.
decisions.reason: 錦、懿 are Jinzhou and Yizhou, and the preceding unit camps at 懿州. Bare “Jin” reads as the dynasty. The proposal still calls 颭軍 “Khitan”; that ethnicity is not in this sentence.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 颭軍千餘出沒剽掠錦、懿間

decisions.after: In the second year of Cheng'an, more than a thousand troops appeared and vanished raiding between Jinzhou and Yizhou; Beidie pursued and defeated them, recovered what had been plundered, and returned it all to the original households.
decisions.reason: The literal must likewise take 錦、懿 as Jinzhou and Yizhou, and 颭軍 is not Khitan.
大睦親府 is the court of imperial-clan affairs; Mujin is a false reading of 睦親.

decisions.after: The encomium says: In the first yin line of the Army hexagram in the Changes: "The army sets forth according to discipline; ill fortune and harm follow."
decisions.reason: 初六 is the first yin line of the hexagram, not “first six.” The parenthetical (chu liu) is unnecessary once that is stated.

claimRevisions.reason: The advanced repair shows 阻珝 is the Zuxu people, not a personal name Beizu Xu created by splitting the ethnonym.
內艱 names mourning for the mother; “a close relative” was produced only by the under-specific English.
The accepted repair restores 張萬公 as Zhang Wangong; Wannu was only a mistransliteration.
The title claim must follow the restored personal name Zhang Wangong.
